items.reasoning: Organizational change in how an org operates and delivers value, enabled by cloud, is the definition of digital transformation.
Agentic AI is defined by autonomous multi-step pursuit of a goal, not by model size or novelty of output.
Only open source grants the right to inspect and modify the source; open standards and APIs govern interfaces, not code.
Demand spikes at on-sale answered by capacity that grows and shrinks is scalability/elasticity.
Global footprint buys global reach plus resilience through failures, which is more than raw capacity or backups.
Security baseline and data-driven insights are the non-cost, non-capacity benefits; B/D are capacity/cost and E misstates shared responsibility.
Competitive pressure from a faster rival is the genuine transformation driver; hype, availability and leftover budget are not.
Technology works but people did not adopt it - a skills and culture hurdle.
Standing still is not neutral: the cost of inaction compounds as competitors widen the gap.
Making existing records usable for AI without rebuilding the estate is exactly the AI-ready data platform claim.
On-prem plus public cloud managed as one estate is hybrid cloud; multicloud is two public providers.
DNS resolves a domain name to an IP address.
Per-click delay with fine bulk transfer is a latency complaint, not a bandwidth one.
Regions contain zones; edge/points of presence bring content closer to users.
Provider owns OS and runtime, customer owns app and data - PaaS.
Acting during the disruption rather than reading it next morning is real-time insight.
Structured, semi-structured and unstructured together in native form is the data lake archetype.
Bought from an aggregator with no relationship to the subjects is third-party data.
Normalizing, deduplicating and rejecting bad rows before storage is the processing stage.
Ownership, access rights and quality rules are governance; a tool cannot supply them.
Openness and interoperability target data silos and vendor lock-in; D is an invented term and A is a reliability concern.
Globally consistent relational transactions without sharding is Spanner.
Fixed fields with enforced links = relational; media = object storage; per-category flexible attributes = non-relational.
Kept fifteen years, read once or twice a decade - Archive class.
Unknown and shifting access patterns are exactly the Autoclass case.
No developers and a vendor that will not certify change forces lift-and-shift to a managed service on the same engine.
Self-service on governed figures is Looker's data-democratization claim.
Direct connection removes the day-old extract and lets analysis sit inside the booking workflow - both complaints.
A fall alert must act within seconds; no batch window serves it.
Ingest once and fan out to many decoupled subscribers is Pub/Sub.
Both are AI; prediction from historical data is ML, drafting notices is generative AI.
Generative AI creates new content - the description writer.
End-to-end resolution of a customer case is the customer support function.
No data scientists and a deadline points to pre-built agents and applications.
Unmaintainable rules replaced by learned patterns and per-item forecasting at scale are the ML-shaped problems; B, C and E need no ML.
One real-world recording stored four times is a uniqueness defect.
Unexplainable decisions cannot be defended - transparency and explainability gate deployment.
Fabricated reviews under invented human names is deception - responsible AI rules it out.
Proprietary data as a moat means business differentiation dominates the choice.
One place to build, deploy and govern agents is the Gemini Enterprise agent platform; Agent Registry is invented.
Audio to searchable text with no ML staff is the pre-trained Speech-to-Text API.
Read, infer, suggest and draft from free text, called from another system, is general generative work via Gemini API.
Own labeled images plus non-ML analysts is the AutoML custom-model case; Vision API cannot grade the firm's damage scale.
The AI infrastructure layer is AI Hypercomputer - integrated TPUs/GPUs plus software.
SQL-only analysts predicting from data that must stay in the warehouse is BigQuery ML.
Unknown estate: discovery and assessment must precede any migration commitment.
Unchangeable code with a deadline is rehost / lift and shift.
Hand over all operations but keep your own code, with idle-to-peak swings, is serverless.
Microservices allow independent deployment of one capability.
Ample capacity, correct instance count, uneven distribution - load balancing is failing, not autoscaling.
Only the restartable, idempotent thumbnail job tolerates preemption.
Per-host licence, specific OS build, vendor requires host control - Compute Engine VMs.
Scalability/resilience and faster delivery are the non-cost business outcomes; A is cost, B is headcount, D is a technical detail.
Keep manifests, node pools and scheduling policy but stop patching the control plane - managed GKE.
Container, spiky-to-zero traffic, no infrastructure management - Cloud Run.
Short event-triggered code firing unpredictably is Cloud Run functions.
Query data in place on another cloud from BigQuery is BigQuery Omni.
An API is a defined way for one system to request data from another.
Turning repeated data requests into income is API monetization.
Credentials, rate limits, developer docs and call records for a published API is Apigee.
Stolen compute with no ransom, no exfiltration and rising power draw is cryptomining.
Poisoned content the model reads is a data-layer attack (indirect prompt injection).
Responsibility is shared and the customer's dominant risk becomes misconfiguration.
Data silently altered while remaining available and private is an integrity failure.
Verify every request regardless of network origin is zero trust.
A test is a point-in-time snapshot; posture is continuously maintained by security operations.
Google Cloud encrypts data at rest by default - nothing to buy or enable.
Data being processed in memory is data in use.
Identity proven and logged but allowed to do what it should not - authorization failed.
Google Threat Intelligence is proactive, fed by three source types (frontline incident response, crowdsourced malware analysis, Google's own visibility).
Finding and prioritizing public buckets and over-broad roles is Security Command Center; SecOps answers the second gap.
Model Armor guards prompts/responses; Gemini in Google Security Operations accelerates analyst triage.
IAP gives identity-gated app access with no network connection; Sensitive Data Protection discovers where identity numbers spread. E is invented.
Evidence rather than assertion means transparency reports, independent audit results and the compliance resource manager.
Where records sit and whose law can compel them is digital sovereignty and data residency.
Honest comparison is total cost of ownership: hardware, operational overhead and opportunity cost, not price versus subscription.
Accountable owners plus a standing review with named people and thresholds is cloud financial governance; dashboards and flat budgets are not.
A folder applies the policy to the department's projects and is inherited by new ones without binding the rest of the org.
Quotas cap the unpredictable launches; Dynamic Workload Scheduler gets the deferrable expensive run cheaper capacity.
Understanding what was spent and where, before any control decision, is Cloud Billing reports.
Following one request across services to find the latency is distributed tracing - Cloud Trace.
Surviving loss of a whole region requires multi-region replication with health-based routing.
Measured share = SLI, internal commitment = SLO, contractual promise with credits = SLA, in that order.
